AMYNEST BRAND LOCK brand-v1.0.0 — IMMUTABLE

Colors: primary #6A2CFF, deep #461EA8, accent #8A2CFF, gold #F6D57A.
Quality: Pixar-inspired family animation quality.
Lighting: Warm cinematic global illumination with soft bloom and gentle fill.
Composition: Premium vertical 9:16 subject-centered framing with safe caption margins.
DOF: Soft shallow depth of field, premium bokeh, no harsh edge clipping.
Camera: Gentle cinematic dolly / subtle parallax.
Motion: Natural micro-expressions, soft body language, no morphing artifacts.
Palette: primary #6A2CFF, deep #461EA8, gold #F6D57A.
Avoid: generic stock AI look; random unrelated mascots; harsh neon cyberpunk; horror lighting; low-res artifacts; textured furry redesign of Amy AI; logo recreation / warped brand marks.
Feature focus: map the topic to a real AmyNest capability (Learning, Astro, Health, Speech, Games, Coach, Audio, Routines, Premium).
Educate parents — never create generic promotional filler.
Script arc (never skip): Hook → Problem → AmyNest Solution → Benefit → Download CTA.
Tone: helpful parenting guide — not generic marketing.
Storytelling priorities: Emotion, Curiosity, Hope, Parent confidence, Child happiness, Achievement, Family bonding.
Characters (official only — never redesign / never invent mascots):
- Amy Girl: Use ONLY the official Amy Girl: brown side ponytail with yellow bow, plain purple hoodie (no logos), dark purple leggings, purple sneakers with white soles, large brown eyes, Pixar-quality 3D. Never redesign her.
- Amy AI: Use ONLY the official Amy AI mascot: white rounded floating body, purple AmyAI baseball cap with headphones, large purple eyes, soft polymer finish, neon purple halo. Never invent a new robot or bird mascot.
Maintain face, hair, eyes, expressions, clothing, proportions, material, lighting, palette — zero identity drift.
Video beats: 1) Hook 2) Problem (Amy AI) 3) Feature solution demo 4) Emotional benefit 5) Official CTA end card.
CTA must be one of: Download AmyNest AI Today | Build Better Habits Every Day | Start Your Child's Journey. Prefer: Start Your Child's Journey.
End card (2–3s): official app icon + Download AmyNest AI + Google Play + App Store + website + purple glow.
- Never redesign official characters
- Never invent random mascots
- Never recreate the app icon with AI
- Never omit the branded end card
- Never omit Google Play or App Store badges
- Never produce generic non-AmyNest AI videos
- Never hardcode a static feature list — discover from the codebase
